content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text made lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity the ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which is what K-S2 forbids.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"the phrase 'without explicit textual resolution' as either forbidden reliance on no single verse stating the link, or permissible weighing of whole chains; I take it as the former because the judge expressly grounds UNDERDETERMINED on lack of explicit resolution.","why":"The judge assigned UNDERDETERMINED because paternity lacked explicit textual resolution, treating the absence of a single verse stating the link as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED in violation of K-S2."}
